text.body:
༄༅༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ārya dza ya ma ti nā ma ma hā yā na sū tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rgyal ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /
evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati sma gṛdhrakūṭe parvate mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena sārdham ardhatrayodaśabhir bhikṣuśataiḥ |
'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' rab tu mang po dag dang thabs cig tu bzhugs so/ /
% !
tatra khalu bhagavān jayamatiṃ bodhisattvam āmantrayate sma |
de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i blo gros la bka' stsal pa/
puṇyārthikena jayamate kulaputreṇa kuladuhitrā vā tathāgatāḥ pūjayitavyāḥ |
rgyal ba'i blo gros rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo bsod nams 'dod pas de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod par bya'o/ /
prajñārthikena śrute 'bhiyogaḥ karaṇīyaḥ
shes rab 'dod pas thos pa la brtson par bya'o/ /
bhogārthikena tyāgo bṛhitavyaḥ |
% bṛṃhitavyaḥ, surely
% note the reversal with Tib.
mtho ris 'dod pas tshul khrims bsrung bar bya'o/ /
svargārthikena śīlaṃ rakṣitavyam |
longs spyod 'dod pas gtong ba sbel bar bya'o/ /
rūpārthikena kṣāntir bhāvayitavyā |
gzugs bzang ba 'dod pas bzod pa bsgom par bya'o/ /
pratibhārthikena guruṣu gauravaṃ kartavyam |
spobs pa 'dod pas bla ma la gus par bya'o/ /
[no Skt.]
gzungs 'dod pas mngon pa'i nga rgyal med par bya'o/ /
sukhārthikena sarvapāpāni parivarjayitāni |
% parivarjayitavyāni, surely
ye shes 'dod pas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa la gnas par bya'o/ /
% !
[61-1-251a] thar pa 'dod pas sdig pa thams cad spang bar bya'o/ /
dhyānārthikena yoniśomanasikāro bahulena bhāvayitavyaḥ |
% !
[no Tib.]
sarvasattvānāṃ sukhārthikena bodhāya cittam utpādayitavyam |
sems can thams cad bde bar bya bar 'dod pas byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya'o/ /
mañjusvarārthikena satyavāditā bhāvayitavyā |
skad snyan pa 'dod pas bden par smra bar bya'o/ /
[no Skt.]
yon tan 'dod pas rab tu dben pa la dga' bar bya'o/ /
dharmārthikena kalyāṇamitrāṇi sevitavyāni |
% sevayitavyāni?
chos 'dod pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten par bya'o/ /
śamathārthikenāsaṃsargo bahulena bhāvayitavyaḥ |
zhi gnas 'dod pas 'du 'dzi med pa mang du bya'o/ /
vipaśyanārthikena śūnyatāpratyavekṣaṇā bahulena bhāvayitavyā |
lhag mthong 'dod pas chos stong par so sor brtag pa mang du bya'o/ /
[no Skt.]
tshangs pa'i 'jig rten 'dod pas byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms bsgom par bya'o/ /
*devamanuṣyasampadarthikena daśakuśalakarmapathāḥ samādātavyāḥ.
% restored from Tatakaragupta
lha dang mi'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa 'dod pas dge bcu'i las kyi lam yang dag par blangs te gnas par bya'o/ /
[no Skt.]
yongs su mya ngan 'da' bar 'dod pas stong pa'i chos la mngon par dga' bar bya'o/ /
sarvaguṇārthikena trīṇi ratnāni pūjayitavyāni |
yon tan thams cad thob par 'dod pas dkon mchog gsum la mchod par bya'o/ /
idam avocad bhagavān āttamanā jayamatir bodhisattvo mahāsattvas te ca bhikṣavo bodhisattvāḥ sā ca sarvāvatī parṣat sadevamānuṣāsuragandharvaś ca loko bhagavato bhāṣitam abhyanandann iti |
bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal ba'i blo gros dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do//
āryajayamatiparipṛcchāsūtram aṣṭamaṃ samāptam |
//'phags pa rgyal ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs so// //
